rows.en: (Luca and I had plans to go to a concert today.)
Did I keep you waiting, Luca?
Good, then.

Oh, the doors are already open.
Shall we hurry?
That was a great concert, wasn't it?

I don't get classical music at all,
but I was really moved.

I haven't had many chances to hear it either,
but live, it's a whole different thing.
You feel it right in your gut.
That's the beauty of live sound.
That was a truly valuable experience.
Well then, shall we head home?

(Luca-kun and I had plans to go
to a concert today.)
Did I keep you waiting, Luca-kun?
Good, then.

I don't get classical music at all,
but I was so moved~
You feel it right in your gut, don't you...

(Luca and I had plans to go see
a concert today.)
rows.notes: raibu: 'concert' per glossary; the first visit (konsaato) is a classical concert, this one a band.

rows.en: Good timing, Luca.
Yes, it worked out just right.
Okay, let's go to the concert.
That was a great concert...

The climax in the second half
was the best...

When they play at that high a level,
you can't help getting pumped up.
You were jumping to the beat too, Luca.
Th-that's not true!

(Luca-kun and I had plans to go see
a concert today~)
You got here at a good time, Luca-kun.
Okay, let's go to the concert~

The climax in the second half
was the best, wasn't it!
You were jumping to the beat too, Luca-kun.
(Luca and I had plans to go to Folmo today.)
Sorry I'm late.
rows.notes: x9. Opens the male visit, but the script also repeats it mid-scene and at the end of both visits, sometimes with Luca's name plate and in the female variant; kept as the plain apology.

rows.en: Honestly, please get it together.

I'm really sorry!
I'll treat you to some soft serve!

You don't have to treat me.
More importantly, where shall we go today?
Since we're here, let's go see the hippo-cows.

Being raised by the Zentradi,
no wonder they're huge.

Can they really hold themselves up
with bodies like that?

They're probably fine, right?
Looking at hippo-cows is making me
want some soft serve.
That's such an offhand answer...
Let's go, Luca.

(Luca-kun and I had plans to go to Folmo
today.)
Sorry I'm late!

Since we're here,
why don't we go see the hippo-cows?

Being raised by the Zentradi,
no wonder they're so big~
Let's go, Luca-kun.
So, what should we do today?
Shall we explore the mall?
Well then, let's get going.
Folmo's really bustling with customers.

It's not as busy as Deep Akihabara, but
there are stalls, and just looking around is fun.
Don't you want to buy anything, Luca?
No, I'm planning to just look around today.
Then come along while I do my shopping.
Sooo, what should we do today?
Yeah, let's go, let's go!
rows.notes: x3, also Ranka in frd_rnk_105 (agreeing to go to the Silver Moon).

rows.en: Huh, don't you want to buy anything, Luca-kun?
Then come along while I do my shopping.

(Today Luca and I came to
the artificial island.)

Hey, Luca, let's skip swimming today
and just take it easy.
That's fine with me.
Bummed you can't go hitting on girls?
What are you talking about...
Not swimming was a fun change, too.

It's a tourist spot,
so there's plenty to see.
Next time I'd like to invite everyone along.
Yeah, that'd be fun.
Well then, shall we head home?

(Today Luca-kun and I came to
the artificial island.)

Hey, Luca-kun, why don't we skip swimming
today and just take it easy?

Aren't you sad you won't get to see me
in my swimsuit?

It's a tourist spot,
so there's plenty to see.
Yeah, that'd be so much fun~

(Luca and I came to the artificial island
again today.)

Let's skip swimming again today
and go exploring.
Exploring? Then let's stay on our toes!
Oh, you're really into it.

The cliffs had quite an atmosphere,
didn't they?

That's a height you wouldn't survive
falling from...
Were we really allowed to go in there?
